external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Exciting news on the hockey front in Loreto with our Minor B hockey team into a Cup final. The girls gave a brilliant display of skill and determination on Monday the 4th of March defeating Middleton College 1 – 0.

There were four short corners taken in the second half but unfortunately none of them turned into goals.
